data.title: Graphic Designer
data.description:
About HOPn UG

Headquartered in Puchheim, Germany, HOPn UG develops smart, scalable solutions across AI automation, software development, digital education, event management, and business consulting. Founded in 2023, our innovation company connects technology, education, and entrepreneurship to empower universities, startups, and enterprises.

Your first months as a Graphic Designer

During your 20-hour-per-week, 3-month remote internship, you will take ownership of visual communication projects across our digital services and educational offerings. You will design engaging graphics, support our branding initiatives, and create visual assets that translate complex technological concepts into clear, compelling media for our global audience.

What you bring to the role

  • A portfolio demonstrating skill in graphic design and visual communication

  • An eye for detail, typography, layout, and modern design principles

  • Familiarity with industry-standard design tools

  • The ability to work independently in a fully remote, international environment

Your first months at HOPn UG

You will have shipped visual assets across multiple digital channels, collaborated directly with our international team on real client and internal projects, and deepened your practical design experience within an innovation-focused company. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single requirement.

data.description:
Humanis Partners, cabinet de conseil et d'accompagnement 360°, recherche pour son client, un(e) ingénieur d'affaires IT BTB H/F, pour la ville de Lille.

Notre client est un acteur régional incontournable, dans la mise à disposition de solutions de digitalisation à destination de PME/PMI, Grands Comptes, et Collectivités Territoriales.

Rattaché(e) au Responsable d'Agence, vous prenez en charge le développement et la fidélisation des ventes sur votre secteur.

Pugnace et doté d'un esprit de compétition, vous organisez vos actions de prospection. Vous assurerez une veille sur certaines entreprises et répondrez en étant pro-actif à leurs demandes de projets et propositions.

Vous connaissez idéalement le secteur et le tissu économique de votre lieu d'exercice.

data.title: Solution Architect - Remote from EU
data.description:
DESCRIPTION OF THE TASKS:

  1. Perform market analysis and/or proof of concept work to validate intended designs and/or identify suitable technologies and products for the purpose of the delivery stream domain and scope;

  2. Follow-up on implementation of approved designs with ICT Engineering and Operations teams, helping clarifying open points and steering the implementation to success wherever needed, providing design knowledge expertise.

  3. More than 6 years of experience in ICT Solution design, specifically on integration architectures (and microservices architectures in the last couple of years)

  4. A minimum of 3 years of experience with Cloud native technologies (microservices, rest APIs, message queues…)

  5. A minimum of 3 years of experience in design and implementation of solutions based on cloud native infrastructure (ex. Kubernetes…)

  6. Participation in a minimum of 3 projects integration of systems

  7. Experience with and participation in the EU Interoperability program

SKILLS AND TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Good knowledge of interoperability technology (e.g. REST APIs, message oriented middleware, service oriented applications)

  2. Good Knowledge of container and orchestration technology (Docker, Kubernetes) on premises and in the cloud Azure/AWS.

  3. Good Knowledge of solution design best practices, create self-explainable documents and diagrams, be able to present architecture decisions and guidelines to varied audiences, self-driven and being able to work in a multi-cultural, self-managed team.

  4. Good Knowledge of security and access management best practices when designing cloud native solutions

Desirable:

Certification: Kubernetes, Azure/AWS Cloud Architecture, Agile, etc.

Delivery mode: Remote (from Europe)

Only European Citizens

Level : Senior (more than 10 years of experience)

Level of Studies: Bachelor or Master Degree
